title: 15m Account Spotlight: Risk-sprint Cuecards & Decision Ledger (Draft)
body:
Purpose:
A minimal 15-minute 'spotlight' QBR standup meant to surface top renewal risks and get immediate decisions or action owners. Use as a pre-QBR warmup or as a recurring account health huddle. Not a replacement for a full QBR — this is triage + decision enablement.

When to use:
- High-velocity accounts where exec time is limited
- Pre-week-of QBR to lock agenda and owners
- Mid-quarter check to escalate new risks to AE/AM/CSM leaders

Attendees (recommended):
- CSM (facilitator) — leads the script
- Account Executive or Renewal Owner — decision authority
- Solutions Eng or TAM (optional) — technical blocker insights
 - Customer Project Lead (if risk is technical/rollout)

Preflight (5–10m before meeting):
- Quick data pull: 30/60/90 day product usage & 3 most recent error/failure logs (Console -> customer view)
- Review last touch notes (Jira/CRM) — flag any open P1/P2s
- Has renewal window been updated in SF? Yes/No (if no -> escalate)
- Prepare 1 slide or 3 bullets for "what changed since last checkpoint"

Meeting Agenda (15 minutes total):
0:00–00:45 — Quick alignment (facilitator intro, goal for the sprint)
0:45–04:00 — Top 3 risk signals (each signal 60–90s):
  - Signal format: title / evidence / impact / ask
04:00–10:00 — Rapid root-cause & mitigation (30s per suggested owner + expected ETA)
10:00–13:00 — Hard decisions & tradeoffs (pricing concession? extended pilot? pause rollout?)
13:00–15:00 — Decision ledger entry + next steps + who owns follow-up

Facilitator script (short cues):
- Start (00:00) — "Quick check: goal is a decision on next steps or an explicit owner + ETA. If we can’t decide here, we’ll escalate to AE by EOD."
- When presenting a signal — "One-line summary, what we’ve seen (data), why it matters to renewal, and the specific ask."
- If discussion stalls — "Two potential actions we can take: A) small mitigation owned by X by DATE, B) escalate to SE/AE for a deep dive. Which one do we pick now?"
- Closing — "I’ll jot decision in the ledger, assign an owner, and follow up with a 10m asynchronous update by EOD."

Risk Signal Checklist (quick yes/no prompts):
- Usage drop >30% over 14 days? Y/N
- New blocker ticket severity >= P2? Y/N
- Exec stakeholder engagement reduced (no exec touch in 30+ days)? Y/N
- Contract milestone missed or delayed? Y/N
- Product change that breaks required workflow? Y/N
- Any upcoming licensing/renewal date in <60 days? Y/N

Decision Ledger (template text — fill during meeting):
- Account: [ACCOUNT_NAME] | Date: [YYYY-MM-DD]
- Signal #: 1
  - Summary: short sentence
  - Evidence: bullets / metric / ticket ids (e.g., JIRA CS-4123)
  - Impact: revenue risk / timeline / adoption metric
  - Decision made: choose from {mitigate, escalate, monitor, pause}
  - Owner: [Name] | ETA: [YYYY-MM-DD] | Follow-up channel: [Slack/Jira/Email]
- Signal #: 2 ... (repeat)

Escalation ladder (if decision needed beyond attendees):
1) AE (renewal decision) — immediate contact if concession or financial ask
2) CSM Lead — for cross-account resource allocation or priority support slots
3) Solutions Lead / Product — for product blocking issues needing fix or workaround
4) VP CS or CFO (rare) — for >15% revenue-at-risk or strategic exec escalation

Follow-up template (post-meeting note — copy/paste into CRM + Slack):
- Subject: [Account] 15m Spotlight - decisions & owners (DATE)
- TL;DR: 2-sentence summary of decision(s)
- Decisions recorded: bullets with owner + ETA (link to decision ledger)
- Actions: short list, link to Jira tickets created (if any)
- Next checkpoint: date/time or async update plan

Quick heuristics for concessions:
- If renewal date <45 days and risk is >medium -> involve AE and Sales Ops for structured concession (do not promise verbally)
- If technical issue prevents function -> offer targeted pilot/extended timeline + SOW for engineering assistance, with cost guardrails
- Never promise credits without AE approval and finance notification

Notes to self / facilitation tips (informal):
- Keep the meeting machine-like: 15m = triage, not debate club. Put timebox on root cause discussion.
- Use the decision ledger as the single source of truth — copy into account SF record immediately after meeting.
- If customer exec doesn’t attend but is critical -> escalate to AE to get sign-off on decisions.
- If multiple signals, prioritize by dollar or dependency (which prevents renewal vs which slows adoption).

Open questions / TODOs (work-in-progress):
- Should we standardize an "evidence pack" (1-pager) for signals so AMs don’t scramble? (proposed owner: Solutions Eng)
- Priority tagging in CRM for Spotlight meetings -> quick filter (proposed owner: RevOps)
- Automate preflight pull (usage + open tickets) -> CS Tools backlog item (JIRA:CS-4988)

Reference links & templates:
- Confluence playbook (draft): CONFLUENCE:CS/spotlight-templates-2024
- Decision ledger sample (sheet): DRIVE:shared/decision-ledgers/spotlight-sample-2024
- Related ticket: JIRA:CS-4123 (customer X rollout blocker)

Quick mock run (script example):
- Facilitator: "We have 15 minutes. Today’s goal: pick one mitigation or escalate to AE. First signal: 40% drop in active seats last 14 days (evidence: usage graph + JIRA CS-4123). Impact: risk to renewal, estimated $120k ARR at risk. Ask: temporary feature-flag rollback or targeted training. Options?"
- AE: "Recommend rollback for 2 weeks and customer exec call — I can own the exec ask."
- Facilitator: "Decision: rollback. Owner: SE (Hannah) by 2024-11-08. AE will schedule exec call by 2024-11-09. I’ll create Jira CS-4234 to track rollback."

Version notes (why different from full QBR):
- Designed for speed and decisions; minimal context, drill into data only when needed; complements longer QBR when there’s time.
- Intentionally prescriptive scripting to reduce meeting overhead and ambivalence.

If you use this, please ping me with improvements. Want to iterate on a 10-card cue pack for CSM phones (short prompts) — low effort, high signal.

Maya (CS Lead) — maya@redwood.ai
